confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Taipei price levels; no live listings, booking pages, or menus were inspected. Restaurant and coffee anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies by district and booking channel. Cocktail and wine are less certain and were cross-checked against the beer anchor (cocktail about 3x beer, wine about 2.5x beer) because direct bar-price knowledge is weaker. FX: the 15 Oct 2026 RBA 4pm rate was taken from the rba.gov.au exchange-rates page as reported in search results; the page was not opened directly, and an unconfirmed third-party 16 Oct figure was not used.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against East Asian peers such as Seoul and Osaka, adjusted downward for Taipei's generally lower dining and hotel price levels. July is treated as a typical summer-season month, with no off-season discount applied to accommodation.
